dogecoin.text:
Dogecoin's moon dreams crash harder than a Solana pump  
Vitalik preaching Layer2 salvation while RNDR HODLers flex AI gains  
Web3's just NFT bros coping with their apes' fade  
Crypto's a circus, and we're all clowns 🤡

Meme coins mooning while your altcoin bags bleed?  
Little Pepe's building a blockchain empire,  
and Dogecoin's still shilling Elon's dreams.  
Wake up, degens - chase the viral hype  
or stay rekt in yesterday's Layer2 promises.
